instruction: Query the OQMD database for Mg-O compounds (element_set=Mg,O) using limit=1. Save the first result returned by the API (entry_id/name/composition/delta_e/stability/spacegroup/volume) to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_12.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
